title: Rural students find belonging at WashU through growing collective
summary_en: WashU’s Rural Students Collective helps students from small towns build community, find academic support and feel at home on campus. Rural enrollment has steadily increased in recent years.
title_cn: Rural students find belonging at WashU through growing collective

title: Breakthrough material gets stronger the more it bends
summary_en: WashU chemists led by Arts & Sciences’ Chenfeng Ke have created a material that gets stronger with use, a discovery with potential medical and industrial applications.
title_cn: Breakthrough material gets stronger the more it bends

title: One tiny sensor, many signals
summary_en: WashU McKelvey engineers paired optical sensors with a new AI approach that decodes hidden patterns in light. The research, led by Lan Yang and Chenyang Lu, paves the way for smaller, smarter sensors for robotics, human health monitoring and cybersecurity.
